plugin.seo.brick.label: SEO
plugin.seo.group.x.help: Optional overrides for X. Empty fields use the social values.
plugin.seo.field.title: SEO title
plugin.seo.help.title: Write a clear, distinct title for this page.
plugin.seo.help.description: Summarize what readers will find on this page.
plugin.seo.help.socialTitle: Leave empty to use the SEO title.
plugin.seo.help.socialDescription: Leave empty to use the meta description.
plugin.seo.help.socialImage: Choose an image that represents this page.
plugin.seo.help.ogType: Use Website for general pages, or Article for editorial content. Extra article metadata can be added below.
plugin.seo.help.xCard: Choose a summary card or a card with a large image. Actual display depends on the platform.
plugin.seo.help.xTitle: Leave empty to use the social title, then the SEO title.
plugin.seo.help.xDescription: Leave empty to use the social description, then the meta description.
plugin.seo.help.xImage: Leave empty to use the social image.
plugin.seo.help.canonicalUrl: The preferred URL for this page or equivalent content. Leave empty for your website to generate its own canonical URL. Include https:// and omit fragments.
plugin.seo.help.following: Normally allow search engines to follow links on this page.
plugin.seo.help.maxSnippet: Optional. -1 allows any length, 0 disables text snippets, and a positive number sets a character limit.
plugin.seo.help.maxImagePreview: Choose the image preview size search engines may display. Leave at Default to omit this directive.
plugin.seo.help.maxVideoPreview: Optional. -1 allows any length, 0 permits a static image, and a positive number sets a limit in seconds.
plugin.seo.help.structuredData: Use a Schema.org @context and @type, an array of such objects, or an @graph of typed objects. Describe only content visible on this page. Structural validation does not guarantee rich results.
plugin.seo.help.metadata: Add tags such as author or article:author. Dedicated SEO fields own description, robots, Open Graph and X tags. These entries do not accept HTML.
plugin.seo.field.name: Name or property
plugin.seo.option.name: name
plugin.seo.preview.label: Preview
plugin.seo.preview.title: Your page title
plugin.seo.preview.description: A short summary of what readers will find on this page.
plugin.seo.guidance.note: Length guides are not ranking scores or search-engine limits.
plugin.seo.image.unavailable: Image details are unavailable. Check your media access and the selected image.
plugin.seo.indexing.noindex: Exclude this page from search. Your website must render noindex and allow crawlers to read it; blocking the page in robots.txt can prevent this.
plugin.seo.indexing.index: Allow search engines to index this page. Your website must render this setting; inclusion in search results is not guaranteed.
plugin.seo.image.altHelp: Describe the image for people who cannot see it.
plugin.seo.image.altFromMedia: Using the image’s alt text. Enter text here to override it.
plugin.seo.image.altFromSocial: Using the social image alt text. Enter text here to override it.
plugin.seo.pageGuidance.label: Page guidance
plugin.seo.summary.label: SEO basics
plugin.seo.summary.help: Checks the title, description and social image, with a small adjustment for text length. This is an editorial guide, not a search ranking score.
